verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a registrar that holds customer and WHOIS contact data, but the evidence never documents retention settings, account-data deletion, or data-export/erasure controls. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: API domain deletion and grace deletions remove domain registrations rather than personal data, and WHOIS privacy hides contact details from public view rather than controlling how long they are kept or whether they are deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
